question: Chief Minister Shramik Kalyan Prakalp scheme was launched by Amit Shah for women of __ __.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For the benefit of those who **labor in tea gardens,** the** Tripura government** has launched the** Chaa Srami Kalyan Prakalpa Yojana.**
 
• **75 of the 7,000 tea garden **employees that labor in Tripura who are benefited by this program are **women.**
 
• Through **54 estates and 21 tea processing factories**, tea is produced in Tripura.
 
• The government has introduced this program under which it will give **tea workers shelter, rations, and essential financial support **in order to maintain their social security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Benefits o**f Mukhyamantri Chaa Srami Kalyan Prakalpa.

 
 
• Instead of receiving rupees 130 per day, tea workers would now receive** rupees 176.**
 
• **Social pension** to all eligible families.
 
• **Social allowance** for helpers in** maternity and pediatric healthcare.**
 
• **Health insurance i**s their ability.
 
• **supporting devices** for people with disabilities.
 
• The government will supervise and coordinate the management to create an environment that is **environmentally favorable.**
